visual_name: White mechanical keyboard with an orbiting camera
summary: A 3D 75% mechanical keyboard with off-white keys, orange accent keys, two black knobs, a small orange display and a red cable, on a white page; the camera zooms out, dives into the keys, spins to vertical and tips low while keys press as if typed.
